hook_text.note: Text wins eye-priority through contrast, not through size

wordmark.note: Overlay applied in production, not rendered in the scene

depth_of_field_factor.note: Subtle separation — not portrait bokeh. Preserve background texture.

occlusion.description: Hero subject partially embedded in or emerging from stone at one or more edges

silhouette_test.description: Hero subject must be identifiable in B&W silhouette at 320px thumbnail width

key_light.character: raking — travels nearly parallel to subject surface to reveal texture
key_light.fall_off: rapid — right side falls to near-black

practical_light.visibility: required — must be visible or strongly implied

fill_light.rule: Shadows must be dark. Fill destroys chiaroscuro.

forbidden_colors.name: pure_white
forbidden_colors.reason: no surface in the scene should be pure white

forbidden_colors.name: pure_black
forbidden_colors.reason: must have warm tint even in darkest shadow

contrast_axis.description: Warm amber illumination vs deep warm shadow — luminance only, no hue contrast

temperature_split.note: Even shadows are warm. No area is cool.

channel_constraints.note: R/B ratio > 2.5 in lit areas. Shadow areas: R/B > 2.0 minimum.

text_vs_subject_balance.text_eye_priority: first — despite smaller area, wins on contrast

thumbnail_laws.name: 66% Darkness Rule
thumbnail_laws.rule: 66% or more of image pixels must be below brightness 25 (near-black)
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Image reads as well-lit room, not underground discovery

thumbnail_laws.name: Single Warm Key Light — No Fill
thumbnail_laws.rule: One warm key light, near-zero fill. Shadows must be deep.
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Multiple light sources or fill light destroys chiaroscuro

thumbnail_laws.name: Text Reads First at 320px
thumbnail_laws.rule: Hook text must be the first eye attractor at 320px thumbnail width
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Mechanism competes with or beats text for first attention

thumbnail_laws.name: Hero Subject Is Discoverable, Not Displayed
thumbnail_laws.rule: Hero subject must be partially embedded in or emerging from environment
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Subject floats freely on clean background — reads as product shot

thumbnail_laws.name: No Empty Voids
thumbnail_laws.rule: Dark zones must be dark AND textured. Pure black (#000000) areas forbidden.
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Large flat-black areas read as compositing artifacts or missing assets

thumbnail_laws.name: All Color Is Warm
thumbnail_laws.rule: No cool colors anywhere. Red/Blue ratio > 2.5 in all lit areas.
thumbnail_laws.exception: Vanishing trace of cool in deepest shadow — not visible at thumbnail scale
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Shadow areas go cool grey/blue — destroys warm underground atmosphere

thumbnail_laws.name: Left-Text Right-Subject Composition Axis
thumbnail_laws.rule: Text always left (≤35% of frame). Subject always right (≥55% rightward). Never inverted.
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Inverted or centered composition breaks designed eye-path

thumbnail_laws.name: Zone Compliance
thumbnail_laws.rule: Top 12% near-pure black (wordmark overlay zone). Bottom 10% clean.
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Content in reserved zones — wordmark becomes illegible

thumbnail_laws.name: Silhouette Test
thumbnail_laws.rule: Hero subject must be identifiable in B&W silhouette at 320px width
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Subject blends into background at thumbnail scale

thumbnail_laws.name: Four Layers Required for Premium
thumbnail_laws.rule: Premium thumbnail requires: base_scene + hero_subject + fx + typography layers
thumbnail_laws.failure_mode: Single-pass generation cannot optimize all four dimensions simultaneously

thumbnail_director.preamble: The Hypogeum Chronicles visual language requires the following constraints on all premium main-episode thumbnails:
constraints: Composition: text left 35%, hero subject right 55-65%, 5-8% breathing gap between them.
Darkness: 60-70% of the frame is near-black. Light is surgical — used only on focal subjects.
Key light: single warm amber torch from upper-left (2200K-2700K). No fill. Deep shadows.
Practical: torch flame or lamp glow visible in upper-left of frame.
Subject: partially embedded in stone at one or more edges. Not a product shot.
Text: aged gold material (cracked stone surface), receives scene lighting, no backing box.
Color: all warm. R/B ratio > 2.5 in lit areas. No cool grey, no blue, no pure black voids.
Zones: top 12% near-pure black. Bottom 10% clean. Four corners near-black (vignette).
Text scale: emphasis word 3× taller than headline. Both serif, warm gold, material-integrated.
Silhouette: hero subject identifiable in B&W at 320px width.

image_prompt_director.preamble: All episode hero images and B-roll stills follow the Hypogeum Chronicles visual language:
constraints: Environment: dark underground stone chamber or ancient vault. Near-black overall.
Lighting: single warm torch or oil lamp from upper-left. Deep chiaroscuro. No fill.
Atmosphere: volumetric torch light, warm dust particles, strong vignette on all corners.
Subject occlusion: partially embedded in or emerging from environment — not displayed.
Color: all warm amber. No cool tones. Even deepest shadows have warm undertone.
Depth: four layers — foreground debris, midground subject, background walls, atmospheric haze.
Foreground: stone fragments or tools partially cut off by frame edge.
Background: rough stone walls with faint carved detail — dark, textured, not competing.
No empty black voids — dark areas must have stone grain or atmospheric texture.

video_prompt_director.preamble: All video shots in The Hypogeum Chronicles series follow this visual language for consistency with the thumbnail and brand:
constraints: Color grade: deep warm amber. Single-source torch/lamp lighting. No ambient fill.
Shadow depth: 60-70% of frame near-black. Light placed surgically on subject and focal detail.
Practical lights: torch flames, oil lamps, or candle light — visible in frame when possible.
Camera movement: slow and deliberate. Reveals through movement, not through brightness.
Depth: always establish foreground / midground / background separation.
Subject integration: subjects emerge from or are embedded in environment — not isolated.
Atmosphere: dust particles in light beams, volumetric haze, warm amber god rays.
Vignette: all shots receive darkened corners in grade — center is focal, edges recede.
No cool tones: no blue sky, no grey ambient, no fluorescent sources. Everything warm.
Stone surfaces: rough, carved texture. Bronze/copper objects: warm patina with verdigris accents.

composite_gap_analysis.primary_fix: Compositor warmth grade is brightening shadow areas too aggressively. Reference achieves 66% near-black; composite achieves ~42%. Reduce contrast enhance, increase vignette strength, or add a shadow-floor clamp step that hard-clips pixels below 30 brightness to the range (8-20, 5-14, 2-8) before final save.
